long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The evening is wound up and so am I, so the beach gets run across.
Dusk is the only time the telescope is worth looking through, and I intend to keep an eye on it.
steps.topic: the first stars over the island

today.reason: Affection is empty, but I will not go looking for it; the zoomies are already calling me down the beach, and I will ignore whatever comes of it.
